name: Deception: path trick -> victim-cached profile -> PII harvest
goal: Make authenticated victims cache their own profile data to public URLs, then harvest at scale.
preconditions: A cache that keys on the path but caches extension-looking requests, plus an authenticated profile endpoint.
impact: PII/tokens of many users extracted from public cache entries.

steps.purpose: Prove the deception: victim profile cached to a public path (/profile/nonexistent.css).
steps.on_success: Identify which data lands in cache; step 3 scales harvest.
steps.on_fail: Cache ignores extensions -> try ;/.jpg trailing tricks, path params, or two-layer (CDN+app) variants.

steps.purpose: Correlate: if profile endpoints take IDs, deception + IDOR multiplies victims per cached entry.
Confirm no throttle on cache reads -> unbounded PII extraction.
steps.on_success: Blast radius = every user who visits the poisoned link pattern.
steps.on_fail: Throttled -> slow-extract within budget; document rate-limit separately.

entry_points: banking/dashboard style apps with static-asset caching

recon.name: Cache extension matrix
recon.how: Request authenticated pages with .css/.js/.ico/.json suffixes and path tricks; diff response headers for cache status.
recon.signal: Cached entry appears for an authenticated body.

recon.name: Two-layer audit
recon.how: Check CDN layer and app layer separately; one may cache what the other would not.

recon.name: Vary analysis
recon.how: Audit Vary headers — missing Vary: Cookie/Authorization is the deception enabler.

recon.name: Cache key simplification
recon.how: param-miner finds unkeyed params; simplification (ignoring query, case, port) widens deception surface.

pivot_hints: pair with smuggling chain for poison+deception combo
document cache behavior map for the client
